description: This file defines the AttendanceRecordListModel class in the OrangeHRM system, representing a model for a list of attendance records. It includes methods for transforming attendance data into an array format suitable for API responses, utilizing associated traits for date/time formatting and number handling.

classes.name: AttendanceRecordListModel
classes.description: A model class for handling and formatting a list of employee attendance records for API serialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an array of attendance record data.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Transforms the internal attendance records data into an array suitable for API responses, formatting dates, times, and calculating durations.
